All wine regions

Coastline and provincial border from geoBoundaries (South Africa ADM1); Olifants, Gamka and Gourits rivers from Natural Earth; towns, roads, other rivers and dams plotted from their real coordinates. Vineyard areas are drawn for orientation and are not official Wine of Origin boundaries. Check opening times and book ahead, especially for appointment-only cellars.

Safari map: borders, rivers, dams and highways from Natural Earth, provinces from geoBoundaries; park and reserve outlines are indicative (Kruger follows the real Mozambique border). Cape Town map: coastline and harbour from geoBoundaries ward boundaries; the street layout is simplified and anchored on surveyed landmarks, so each spot links to Google Maps for exact directions. Venue details were checked in October 2026 against Inside Guide, Cape Town Magazine, Time Out Cape Town, Eat Out and Star Wine List; restaurants change fast, so check before you go.

Lion Sands map: the Sabie River follows ward-boundary data; lodges, gates, Skukuza camp and the airport are plotted from their coordinates; the Sand River's course, reserve boundaries and roads are approximate; habitats, waterholes, drive loops and animal areas are illustrative, not live sightings. Rhino locations are deliberately not shown. The Green Point pin marks the neighbourhood, not an address.
